content:
elaina_cs: FYI incoming from Acme support. Customer reports their $500 trial credit is missing from their main org after signup via GitHub SSO. They can see a 'staging' workspace that has the balance. Customer org: AcmeCorp, primary org_id: org_acme_01, contact: prod@acme.com

samir_cs: I pulled their org in the admin UI — looks like two workspaces under the account. One is ws_prod_342 (attached to org_acme_01) with 0 credit, and another auto-created ws_auto_987 showing $500.

samir_cs: admin console snippet:
```
GET /admin/orgs/org_acme_01/workspaces
[
  { "id": "ws_prod_342", "name": "AcmeCorp", "credits_usd": 0 },
  { "id": "ws_auto_987", "name": "AcmeCorp (staging)", "credits_usd": 500 }
]
```

elaina_cs: thanks. Customer says they had a teammate invite during the SSO flow — probable race that created a duplicate workspace. Can we migrate the credits to the prod workspace without interrupting anything? :thinking_face:

jordan_sre: technically safe to reassign credits at the billing layer. We just need to ensure KV cache/usage counters aren't double-counted. Migration steps: 1) block new token issuance for ws_auto_987, 2) move credits, 3) reconcile usage for last 24h. Should take ~15-30m.

samir_cs: repro notes for internal follow-up: 1) User signs up via GitHub SSO, 2) rapid invite created by teammate before org creation finishes, 3) backend creates second workspace with separate workspace_id. Tagging this as "SSO-invite race" pattern.

elaina_cs: I told customer we'll investigate and asked for go-ahead to move credits. They replied: "Please move them, we need to start testing ASAP."

david_billing: I can run the manual transfer. Command I will run (internal only):
```
billing-cli transfer-credits --from-workspace ws_auto_987 --to-workspace ws_prod_342 --amount 500 --reason "misallocated trial on duplicate workspace"
```

billing-bot: Created billing ticket BILL-2219 for manual credit transfer. Approvals required: CS owner + Billing lead.

elaina_cs: approved. I confirm customer OK with manual move.

david_billing: running transfer now. Will monitor transactions and update audit log. :eyes:

david_billing: DONE — transfer succeeded. Audit ID audit_2026_000123. Post-transfer balances:
```
ws_prod_342: credits_usd = 500
ws_auto_987: credits_usd = 0
```

david_billing: Reconciled recent usage (last 24h). No double-charge detected. Logged migration in BILL-2219.

elaina_cs: pinged customer with confirmation and screenshots. They confirmed billing shows $500 on their main org and can start tests. :white_check_mark:

jordan_sre: filing a short runbook snippet to reduce repeat cases: add a de-dupe step in org creation flow that checks for existing verified domains/emails and delays invite->org finalization by 3s. I'll create an eng ticket.

samir_cs: marking thread resolved on our side. Thanks everyone.

billing-bot: BILL-2219 moved to status: resolved. Notes: credits manually reassigned per customer consent.
